During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a '''refinery''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]] to process [[hydrocarbon]]s. The refinery was destroyed by a joint [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&mdash;[[Sessehshellah]] assault.
